atoms.sound: After saving for a long time, I finally had enough money to buy a new bike. Since my favourite colour is green, I chose a bright-green bike. Molly, Samira, Raj and Ben all wanted to have a go on my bike.

atoms.sound: As the sun set, the sky began to rumble loudly. Black, grey, and purple clouds rolled overhead. Usually a very brave boy, Rory was terrified of storms and ran to his parents. In contrast to the dreadful weather outside, his parents’ room was cosy, warm and safe.

atoms.sound: At the party venue, Melissa spent hours setting up for the party. She had invited friends from university, from work, from her home town and from her running club.
